Dialogue: Let me...

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Wait, wait, wait.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: ...(garbled) a couple.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Yeah, but let me brush... (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Well, you can get rid of a lot of it, kicking that way...

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Yeah.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: ...Get it out of your soles of your boots.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay; go ahead on up.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Oh, okay. (Pause)

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Ohh, I'm in this dingy television wire again. (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: There we go.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: steps back to better view the LM hatch
Dialogue: All right; I'll help you from back here as best I can.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: That's a good idea. I'm going to raise my gold visor here so I won't scratch it; and just put my protective visor down. (Pause) There. (Pause) Now, see the hatch? When you come up, take a good look at the hatch (and look at the scratches it got when they got out at the start of the EVA). (Pause) I'm really going to have to be tender about it. I'm not sure we're not going to want to put some tape over it or something. (Pause) Okay.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: All the way down. Raise your rear end. (Pause) That a boy. Got her. (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
LMP_Status: kneeling on the porch with his upper body in the cabin
Dialogue: That's as far in as I can go. I'll just do a pushup.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Slide in some more. I'm in.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Very good.

Speaker: LMP
LMP_Status: inside the LM
Dialogue: In the hatch, Houston.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger, Al. Copy. You're in.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Maybe your old friendly "Cerd" (that is, CDR) will get the ETB.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: returns to the ETB to transfer his equipment to LMP
Dialogue: Okay; just a second. Let me get my gear (the LEC). (Pause) Okay. Just a second.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: An ETB and two cameras (inside the ETB) ready to come up. (Pause) Oh, there's my friend (the TV wire), again. Al Bean?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: What?

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: That thing's going to drive me buggy. Guess what.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Houston?

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: (Making a mis-identification) Go ahead, Pete.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Do you want me to switch to lunar stay antenna right now while Pete's on the surface? Over.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger. That's affirmative. And Track Mode, Off.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay. I'm going to Lunar Stay right now; but we may lose comm for a second. If I don't hear from you, I'll come back up.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger.

Speaker: LMP
LMP_Status: switches to the erectable S-band antenna (from the S-band antenna on the LM)
Dialogue: Stay. (Long Pause) Houston, Apollo 12. How do you hear on Lunar Stay?

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Intrepid, you're loud and clear. Sounds like Pete did the job (of erecting the S-Band correctly).

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: (Garbled) start this ETB and... (Stops to listen to Gibson) Sure did.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Got good signal strength, Houston?

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Go ahead and start the ETB up.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: (To Gibson) I'm going Track Mode to Off.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: (To Conrad) Okay. Now... Just a second, Pete, I haven't got this ETB (means LEC) rigged. One second.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. (Pause)

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Intrepid, signal strength is good. (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Matter of fact, you sound stronger, Houston.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: I believe so, Pete.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Need to mount it.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Got it.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: We've got it. Wait a second; let me clear a nice little room here for it. (Pause) Say, are we going to jettison this garbage bag at the end of this EVA, Pete?

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Yes, sir.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay, let me get it in good position.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Why don't you throw it out right now?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: That's a good idea.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: And I'll get rid of it (by tossing it under the descent stage).

Speaker: LMP
LMP_Status: places jettison bag on porch
Dialogue: That's a good idea; you can move it out of the way. That's a smart one. (Pause) Okay, here it comes. (Pause) Just a second.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Just a second. (Pause)

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Don't worry about it.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay. It won't bother us (during the LEC operations). Get it when you come up.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Haul her (the ETB) up.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay. Just a second. (Pause) Let me try something that might be just easier on all of us. I don't have to run one over a pulley; I can just pull it up, Pete.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: It doesn't weigh anything.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: That's right! Who needs a pulley? It's easier this way.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Wait a minute. Go ahead, pull. (Counting quickly) 1, 2, 3. That a boy.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Hey, I got an idea. Now, you pull. You pull.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Wait a minute. Nah; it's making a mess (by throwing dirt everywhere)! Never mind. Just keep on pulling.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay. (Pause) Okay; just a second.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: All right. (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Equipment transfer bag, in. Secured. (Long Pause) Okay, bring her (the LEC hooks) on back, Pete.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. Wait, wait. Don't let it get hung up. Keep coming.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Let her go.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: No, wait a minute, now. Just keep it taut.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Ahhhh! See, you can't do it that way, Al. Take it easy. Just get it out slow. That a boy. That a boy. Now. Now, you can let go of it. (Long Pause) Here is that. (Pause) We got one rock box coming up. Okay, Al. Easy does it; easy does it. Wait a minute, now. Easy does it. Easy, easy! Easy! Easy! Easy! You're pulling when I don't want you to pull! Okay; now pull. (Pause) Okay. Now we've got to give it the heave-ho (to get it over the porch lip). Ready? 1. 2. Pull.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Got it made. Okay, lift her up a little bit, Pete. Let it come forward.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: That baby is heavy.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: That's right in the door, though! Let me slide that in here.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: transfers SRC 1 into LM
Dialogue: Okay. Okay, Houston. One rock box inside.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger, Pete. Copy. One SRC in. (Long Pause)

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay, bring her out.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. (Pause) Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait! This thing is like playing with a snake. (Al laughs) Okay. That a boy. Now; easy does it. Get all this good stuff (his end of the LEC) and put it over here in the gear pad. Okay; now. Hey, Al? Now, you're going to hang on to it (Al's end of the LEC) and hand it to me, right? So I can tie it on the porch? Al?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: That's right!

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. (Pause) Am I dirty. (Long Pause) Okay, Houston. What do you want me to do? Get in?

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: That's affirmative, Pete. If you've got the ETB and the rock box in, then climb in yourself. (Long Pause)

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Intrepid, Houston. (No answer; Long Pause) Intrepid, Houston. (No answer; Pause)

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: You all ready for me to come in, Al?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: I'm ready. It's up to them.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Wonder what happened to Houston.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: I'm not sure that that Lunar Stay didn't do it. I'd rather go back on Track and get them back.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Intrepid, Houston. Stand by.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: (Hearing Houston) Okay. What's your problem?

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Okay, we had a changeover from one site to another, down here. It was all on our end. No problem with your antenna. It's working well.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. You guys ought to call those things (the site handovers) out in advance. That's been happening all the way through this flight.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Roger, Pete. We concur.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: And go ahead and press on on the ingress.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: steps onto the +Z footpad
Dialogue: Okay. (Pause) All right, Houston. Mark. I'm on the footpad.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Mark. (Long Pause)

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: jumps onto the bottom rung of the ladder
Dialogue: (Jumping up to the first rung) That was easy.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: I just closed my feedwater. You might want to do that, too.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Probably a good idea. Let me see if I can find it back here. (Pause) Okay, I just closed mine. Coming up the ladder.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Gosh, you're shaking the whole LM.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Sorry about that.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: You'll get a warning, because you haven't got your feedwater, but that's okay. You've got cooling for quite a while.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: at the top of the ladder; discards the jettison bag
Dialogue: Yeah. Understand. Okay, one garbage bag (meaning the jettison bag). Anything else in there you want to get rid of?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Not a thing.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: All right, hand me the LEC.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay, the LEC's got kind of a little slip knot in it because the... Got it?

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Yeah.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Pete, on your way through the hatch, will you give a check on the seal?

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Check on the seal.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay; I can see it probably better than he could from this side, Houston. Seal looks real good. I'll tell you what we did do; when we got out, we...

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: I can't believe I did that.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Yeah, you did. Because I remember, you were hitting here and then when I backed up. I could... I'll tell you, we probably just ought to put a piece of tape over it.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. (Hearing a warning tone) That's my feedwater (garbled).

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: (Garbled) the skin on the hatch, and for about a 10-inch cut, there. And it didn't hurt the insulation; didn't hurt the hatch. And I don't know whether you want us to put a piece of tape on there or just forget it. It doesn't look like it's going to bother anything.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: I'd say just forget it.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay, Pete.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Why don't you get over on your side?

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay. Let me move over.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: I just checked your circuit breakers, and they're all good.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: All right. (Pause)

Speaker: LMP
CDR_Status: moves to the edge of the LM porch to close the dump valve
Dialogue: Just a second; I'm not out of the way, yet.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: All right; but I want you to hold the door for a minute while I...

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: ...close this front (dump valve)...

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Well, I've got to get out of the way.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: ...front thing here.

Speaker: CC
Dialogue: Pete, we concur. No tape.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: (To Al) All right.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: (Responding to Gibson) Okay.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Now, wait a second, Pete. Let me back up a little better.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay. Tell me which way to go.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: Just a second. Okay, you're just perfect. Shoot right on in. Put your chest down and your rear end up (probably to get the OPS and the top of the PLSS in)... There you go; got it. Go a little bit to the left. Get a little further (into the cabin) until your head bumps (against the midstep). Do a pushup and you're fat. Little bit to the left, little bit further to the left. That's it. Up.

Speaker: CDR
Dialogue: Okay.

Speaker: LMP
Dialogue: You're in the best possible position. Scoot in a little more. There; you got it.

Speaker: CDR
CDR_Status: inside LM
Dialogue: I'm in; no sweat.
